column1: A second arithmetic trick follows as a corollary to the first: The percentage change of a ratio is approximately the percentage change in the numerator minus the percentage change in the denominator. Again, consider an example. Let Y denote GDP and L denote the population, so that Y/L is GDP per person. The second trick states that Percentage Change in (Y/L)  (Percentage Change in Y)  (Percentage Change in L).
